title: Widefleet: Open-source platform for agent-built apps and workflows.
excerpt: Let agents deploy apps and workflows with company login, databases, file storage, and controlled access to your systems.
content_html:
Let agents deploy apps and workflows with company login, databases, file storage, and controlled access to your systems.

Get started See how it works

Build an app your team can use.

Work in Claude Code, Codex or your preferred editor. Widefleet handles company login, app data and deployment.

Company login

Your systems

Infrastructure

Requests

Reports

Projects

  • Use your preferred coding agent
  • Add a database and file storage
  • Deploy updates through the CLI

The platform

What your apps run on.

Built for coding agents

Your coding agent creates and manages apps through the Widefleet CLI, in the editor you already use.

Company login & app access

Connect your company’s identity provider and decide who can access each app. Your team signs in with its existing accounts.

Databases & file storage

Store records, documents and attachments. Each app gets its own database and private file storage, preserved across code deployments.

Connect your company systems

Build connectors to your existing systems and decide which apps can use them.

Background jobs & schedules

Run recurring tasks on a schedule and process queued work in the background, even when nobody has the app open.

Deployments, previews & logs

Deploy changes, test them in isolated previews, inspect logs and errors, and roll back to an earlier code version when needed.

Open source

The full platform,
open source.

The management service and app runtime are open source. Read the code, change what you need, and run your own installation.

  • Inspect the platform and runtime code
  • Build and maintain your own extensions
  • Self-host independently of Widefleet Cloud

Self-hosted

Run the complete platform in your own cloud or on your own servers. You control the environment.

  • Manage your own installation

  • Keep your apps and data in your environment
Explore self-hosting

Managed hosting

Widefleet Cloud

Build your apps without operating your own Widefleet installation.

  • Fully managed: we run the platform, apps and storage
  • The same open-source foundation
Get started with Cloud

FAQ

Common questions.

What do I need to self-host?

The reference installation uses Linux and Docker Compose. You run the management service, app runtimes and company login in your environment. PostgreSQL and object storage can also be connected as external services.

Is Widefleet open source?

Yes. The complete self-hosted platform is open source. Browse the code and setup instructions in our GitHub repository.

Do I need a particular coding agent?

No. Work with Claude Code, Codex or your preferred editor. The current starter is a regular SvelteKit project. App development runs locally with Node.js and pnpm; the Widefleet CLI handles deployment.

Get started

Deploy your first app.
